about_the_game:
The creative team of "Extreme Rescue", UE Culture, has been deeply engaged in the film and television industry for many years, with superb production standards, and has produced a number of high-quality online dramas.The team is in direct control of the production from pre-script writing, mid-shooting to post-production.His works include the brain-burning suspense drama "Hair Deception" series, absurd suspense drama "Kill or Die", fantasy suspense brain-burning drama "Foreign Objects", urban suspense drama "The Edge of the City", campus comedy "Spicy Next Door" series, and more than twenty online dramas and online movies such as the online movie "The Very Bodyguard", "It is Better to Solve the Wrongs Than to Tie the Ties", "The Gold Medal Bodyguard", etc. He has also worked as an assistant to the director in the production of the online movie "The Gold Medal Bodyguard", which was produced by his team.

Rich Characterization

Follow the male protagonist's point of view to realize immersive deduction and detection, and according to your choice, you will unlock different emotional lines with female characters with very different personalities, and play around with rich colorful egg plots and diverse endings.

 

Diverse Immersive Interactive Content

Secret room escape, road movie escape, casino storm, puzzle solving and exploration, real-time immersive interactive ...... different styles of plot and interactive content complement each other, follow the main character to experience diverse identity experiences.

 

Movie and TV Class Audition Enjoyment

The well-produced graphics allow you to immerse yourself in real-life situations, and the multiple reversals and suspenseful storyline allow you to explore the process, bring in the character's senses, and go deeper into it.

 

Combination of Ideal and Reality

The storyline is close to reality, but the options are rich and bold, allowing you to break through reality, punish evil and be your own hero, and your choices will determine the fate of everyone and the development of events.

 

Professional-grade action direction

The tension of close combat, the power of one against ten, numerous action scenes, each move is carefully designed to give you an immersive experience of fist-pumping excitement, the atmosphere and rhythm of pulling full.

Developer says-

Hello everyone, we are UE Culture, our team was initially recognized for our suspenseful dramas, and suspenseful reasoning has always been the type of story that we are better at, through the interlocking plots and cleverly designed clues laying, so that the audience follows the characters' footsteps forward, and can encounter unexpected surprises at the turning point, which has always been the direction of our efforts.Suspenseful reversal should be both reasonable and unexpected, need to enrich the backstory and journey of each character, focusing on the fate and growth of the little people, closer to you and me, digging out the great dreams and fearless courage hidden under the ordinary appearance, so that they break through the reality of the heavy obstacles, to become their own heroes, which is the original intention of our creation.

In order to better combine film and television with interactive games, we incorporate different themes into them, such as casino, escape room, road movie escape, etc., to increase the experience and feelings of players in different identities and interactive scenarios, and strive to make a work that is not only nice to look at, but also fun to play.

In the whole process of research and development of the work, we also went through twists and turns, and finally chose in the beautiful scenery of Qiandao Lake scenic shooting, to find professional martial arts director and game production team, work together, in order to be able to present a better picture and interactive experience, and even more hard work is worth it, because we are honored to finally let this work come out, and look forward to you to be able to give us valuable advice and feedback to help us polish out a better work.We look forward to your valuable suggestions and feedback to help us polish our work.

Thanks again for your support and attention, because we can keep going because of you.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains scenes of crime, violence, gunplay and fighting, and is not suitable for minors.

The adult content in this game is mainly the picture caused by gunplay and fighting in the plot, as well as crime and violence, which only appear in specific maps or specific scenes, and do not require specific levels or rankings to unlock content, which will appear with the development of the live-action interactive movie plot.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 或 AMD equivalent 或以上
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 780 or AMD HD 7950 with 3GB VRAM minimum (Support of Vulkan 1.1 required)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 或 AMD equivalent 或以上
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 with 4GB VRAM minimum (Support of Vulkan 1.1
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

short_description: Ex-cop's life shatters when kidnappers take his daughter, implant a bomb, and force him on lethal missions. With enigmatic allies, his choices rewrite destinies while unraveling a conspiratorial web.
